item.title: Man arrested for recording guests without their knowledge at Oakhurst rental property, deputies say
item.description: An Oakhurst rental home owner is behind bars and accused of turning family vacations into nightmares by recording his guests during their most private moments.

item.title: 12 arrested in online child predator sting operation out of Merced
item.description: 12 men are now sitting in a cell, instead of behind a screen. They're suspected of trying to arrange contact with potential victims online who they thought were children.

item.title: Woman shot and killed after early morning argument in Hanford, police say
item.description: A woman is dead following a shooting in Hanford early Monday morning. Authorities were initially called out to reports of a man and woman arguing and possibly fighting before hearing gunshots.

item.title: 9-year-old pianist's 'fingers turn into dancers' as he wows audiences
item.description: He has performed at countless recitals and competitions, although his legs are not yet long enough to reach the pedals.

item.title: Registration open for Great American Cleanup in Fresno
item.description: As part of Mayor Jerry Dyer's plan to celebrate America's 250th birthday, the city is expanding volunteer opportunities by hosting 25 cleanup and beautification sites across town.

item.title: Authorities investigating inmate murder at Kings County prison
item.description: In Kings County, the California Department of Corrections and Rehabilitation is investigating the murder of an inmate.

item.title: Epic Games to lay off more than 1,000 employees amid Fortnite downturn
item.description: Epic Games cites declining Fortnite engagement and industry-wide slowdown as it cuts more than 1,000 jobs.

item.description: Find exclusive offers on spring and Easter essentials with exclusive deals from ABC Secret Savings.

item.description: Marvel Television's 'Daredevil: Born Again' is back for the highly anticipated second season on Disney+.

item.title: Young Chowchilla golf star heads to Chevron Championship after strong finish in the 'City of Stars'
item.description: Asterisk Talley will make her next start this week at the Chevron Championship, the first major championship of the year, teeing off Thursday in Houston, Texas.

item.description: The New York City movie premiere for the sequel brought some of Hollywood's biggest stars.

item.description: The satirical news outlet The Onion has a new plan to take over conspiracy theorist Alex Jones' Infowars platforms and turn them into parodies.

item.title: Kiddieland at Applegate Zoo in Merced set to reopen after undergoing renovations
item.description: Kiddieland, the nostalgic amusement park located inside Merced's Applegate Zoo, is welcoming visitors once again after undergoing major renovations.

item.title: Housing Watch: Quieter Spring market compared to past trends
item.description: Spring is typically a time when home buying picks up. With high home prices and high mortgage interest rates, that has not been the case this season.

item.title: Shooting at pyramids near Mexico City leaves 1 Canadian tourist dead, 6 people injured
item.description: A man with a gun opened fire Monday at the historic Teotihuacán pyramids, killing one Canadian tourist and injuring six other people at the tourist site an hour outside of Mexico's capital, the Mexican government said.
